title: Player falling below level boundary does not trigger death (player_out_of_bounds)
explanation: At frame 2502, the player falls below OUT_OF_BOUNDS_Y (1400.0) reaching y=1412.43, logging player_out_of_bounds anomaly. Traced to Player.gd:L254-L270 where detection logs an anomaly but never calls die(), causing the player to fall indefinitely through the void past y=320,000 without dying or respawning. This violates the physical and design invariant that falling out of the world must be fatal.
